			crown_estate

			if = {
				limit = {

						}

				}

		}

		ai_will_do = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root = {
						capital.market = {
							"goods_supply_in_market(goods:goods_gold)" > 0
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "has gold"
					value = 100
				}
			}
		}

		years = 2
	}

	silver_coins = {
		country_modifier = {
			silver_used_for_minting = yes
			silver_impacts_inflation = 0.1
			goods_gold_impacts_inflation = -1.0

			minting_inflation_threshold = 0.01
			minting_income_factor = 0.2
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
		}

		ai_will_do = {

				limit = {
					root = {
						capital.market = {
							"goods_supply_in_market(goods:silver)" > 0
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "has silver"
					value = 100
				}
			}
		}


		years = 2
	}

			silver_used_for_minting = yes

			goods_gold_impacts_inflation = -1.0

			minting_income_factor = 0.2

						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "has silver and copper"
					value = 200
				}
			}
		}
		years = 2
	}

	barter_exchange = {
		potential = {
			capital.market = {
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:goods_gold)" <= 0
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:silver)" <= 0
				"goods_supply_in_market(goods:copper)" <= 0
			}
		}
		country_modifier = {
			goods_gold_impacts_inflation = -1.0
			silver_impacts_inflation = -1.0

			minting_inflation_threshold = 0.01
			minting_income_factor = 0.02
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					capital.market = {
						"goods_supply_in_market(goods:goods_gold)" <= 0
						"goods_supply_in_market(goods:silver)" <= 0
						"goods_supply_in_market(goods:copper)" <= 0
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "has no metals"
					value = 200
				}
			}
		}
		years = 2
	}

	stavraton_coin_policy = {
		unique = yes
		potential = {

			}

		years = 2
	}

REPLACE:precious_metal_distribution_law = {
	law_category = socioeconomic
	potential = {
		OR = {
			produced_in_country:goods_gold > 0
			produced_in_country:silver > 0

			has_law = precious_metal_distribution_law
		}
	}

	gold_export_ban = {
		potential = {
			NOT = { is_subject_type = colonial_nation }
		}
		country_modifier = {
			ban_exports_of_goods_gold = yes
			ban_exports_of_silver = yes
			global_goods_gold_output_modifier = -0.05
			global_silver_output_modifier = -0.05
			minting_income_factor = 0.66
			monthly_towards_mercantilism = societal_value_tiny_monthly_move
			export_impact_on_demand = 0.05
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
		}
		years = 2

		ai_will_do = {
			# forbid precious metal export for AI as its too hard to chicken and egg if they would get profitable exports or not
			value = -100
		}
	}
	regulated_gold_export = {
		country_modifier = {
			selling_efficiency = tiny_trade_efficiency_bonus
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
	unlimited_gold_export = {
		country_modifier = {
			global_merchant_power = 0.1
			global_goods_gold_output_modifier = 0.05
			global_silver_output_modifier = 0.05
			minting_income_factor = -0.66
			monthly_towards_free_trade = societal_value_tiny_monthly_move
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			burghers_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
}

REPLACE:amazigh_familial_connections = {
	unique = yes
	law_category = socioeconomic
	potential = {
		capital ?= {
			region ?= region:maghreb_region
		}
		"estate_power(estate_type:tribes_estate)" > 0
	}

	reliance_on_local_tribes = {
		country_modifier = {
			global_tribes_estate_power = 1
			land_cost_on_distance_from_capital_speed_propagation = 0.1
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			tribes_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
	cordial_relations = {
		country_modifier = {
			tribes_estate_target_satisfaction = small_permanent_target_satisfaction
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			crown_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
	refuse_recognition = {
		country_modifier = {
			tribes_estate_target_satisfaction = big_permanent_target_satisfaction_penalty
			monthly_legitimacy = 0.075 # VANILLA = 0.1
		}
		estate_preferences = {
			nobles_estate
		}
		years = 2
	}
}
